name: Reviews
description: Gets every pull request a review on the day it is opened.

brings: A table of open pull requests and their reviewers
A nudge for anything open four hours
The week's number in Pages, every Friday

how: Every pull request is a row in pull_requests, with when it was opened
Anything open four hours without a review gets a nudge to a reviewer
never: Approve or merge a pull request

outcome.sentence: Every pull request is reviewed the same day.
outcome.measure: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE reviewed_same_day) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) FROM pull_requests WHERE opened_at >= date_trunc('week', now())
